instruction: Freeze best dev design by 04:30, then one frozen test evaluation completed by 06:30; use stratified sample if full test cannot finish. No design changes after freeze.
test_sampling_policy: Choose once before test calls from measured DEV throughput. Proportional stratification with a fixed seed; state sample size and 95% interval. Never tune on test outcomes.
audit_policy: Freeze DEV corrections and TEST audit corrections before test predictions; retain official labels and original scorer.
